messages:
jenna_cs: kicking off a short sync — we need to lock the quota window for VegaHealth's dedicated pool before next week. who can confirm the expected steady qps?

mike_sre: put me on it. will pull last week's shadow traffic and propose target qps by EOD.

diego_eng: FYI their baseline is ~1.8k qps with 95th p95 spikes to 2.6k during morning batch. plan was to request a 3k steady quota with 4k burst.

jenna_cs: thanks. my ask: quota window must allow autoscale headroom + one degraded fallback tier. sam_pm, is that acceptable for their SLA?

sam_pm: yes, SLA target is 99.9% latency < 300ms. fallback to smaller model is allowed for non-critical routes. need ops runbook updated.

ellie_support: capture for enablement: we'll need a short doc for their oncall about how to interpret the quota metrics and when to trigger escalation. I'll draft.

mike_sre: proposed autoscale thresholds: scale-up at 65% GPU util, scale-down at 35%, cool-down 60s. can we simulate?

diego_eng: those thresholds look fine. we'll also add a soft throttle at 85% to prefer stalls to OOM.

jenna_cs: load test window — prefer wed 09:00-12:00 PT. can we do a warmup + steady + spike plan?

loadbot: scheduled job created: locust master -> workers x8. job id: lv-5301.

mike_sre: test plan snippet:
```
phase 1: 15m warmup @ 500 qps
phase 2: 45m steady @ 3k qps
phase 3: 10 x 1m spikes to 4k qps spaced 5m apart
metrics: p50/p95/p99 lat, 5xx rate, GPU mem.
```

jenna_cs: perfect. diego, can you add KV-cache priming before phase 2? we saw cold-cache penalties last time.

diego_eng: will do. priming script: `curl -sS https://vega/testset | xargs -n1 -P200 -I{} ./call_inference.sh {}`. I'll drop the sanitized script in the runbook.

ops_bot: reminder: request for KMS access for VegaHealth service account pending approval.

tara_re: legal signoff on data residency is complete. ops just needs the KMS key policy attached.

jenna_cs: timeline: approve quota request today -> autoscale config and runbook by tomorrow -> load test wed 09:00 PT -> postmortem + enablement doc by friday.

mike_sre: I'll run the smoke today in staging at 16:00 PT and paste results here.

ellie_support: I'll prepare the oncall quicksheet and a short Loom showing where to read the telemetry.

sam_pm: ping me after smoke. I'll confirm go/no-go for production quota increase.

jenna_cs: blockers?

mike_sre: only blocker is the KMS policy attach — once that's in, GPU access and load tests are green.

jenna_cs: ok noted. tagging @diego_eng and @ellie_support to update artifacts. :thumbsup:

diego_eng: uploading priming script and a trimmed load script to the shared runbook now: https://redwood.work/r/vega-runbook

mike_sre: pasted smoke logs: `p95=180ms p99=420ms errs=0` — staging looks healthy.

jenna_cs: excellent. I'll submit the quota request for 3k steady / 4k burst and cc ops.

ops_bot: quota request submitted (ticket #Q-8921). awaiting capacity team's ack.

sam_pm: nice work everyone. post-test I'll collect customer feedback and schedule a 30m enablement with VegaHealth SREs.

ellie_support: adding a single page 'how to read quota events' to the enablement pack.

jenna_cs: thanks all — we'll reconvene after load test for debrief. :rocket:
